description: Step 3 of transactional email setup, once the transactional domain is verified: create a sender address such as hello@mail.example.com. Replies go to the chosen mailbox. Then send from the address with a message send (the first one to your own address is the test send) or create an SMTP credential for it.

display_name.description: The sender name recipients see, such as Acme.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

local_part.description: The part before @: hello sends from hello@mail.example.com.

mailbox_id.description: The mailbox that receives replies. Its address becomes the sender's Reply-To.

name: shipmail_create_transactional_sender
title: Create Transactional Sender
